data.body: Consolidated into epic compliant-lemon-grunion (759e-7dc1-675c-4877) as a child story (type changed epic→story; status stays idea). Reframed as the optional human-adjudicated enrichment on top of the free outcome labels that expectable-clownlike-ynambu derives from the corpus (plan_defect closes, caused_by links, PASS→completion-FAIL, revise→re-review finding survival, identical-material noise floor). The "$0.30/finding" LLM-evidence cost counts against the epic's $200 Bedrock cap if this is promoted, so keep it small (≈100 findings) and decide after the label-proxy metrics are in hand.
